name: Savanna
author: XNinety9
description: Fullscreen app launcher: a paged grid of every application, filtered as you type.

schema.label: Size
schema.description: Fullscreen like Launchpad, or a bordered card in the middle of the screen.

schema.label: Card width
schema.description: Fraction of the screen width. Centered size only.

schema.label: Card height
schema.description: Fraction of the screen height. Centered size only.

schema.label: Card border (px)
schema.description: Uses the theme's Hyprland active border colour; override with [savanna] border in shell.toml.

schema.label: Card corner radius (px)
schema.description: Leave unset to follow the theme's corner radius.

schema.label: Page direction
schema.description: Horizontal: pages side by side, dots below. Vertical: pages stacked, dots on the right.

schema.label: Icon size (px)
schema.description: Largest icon size; icons shrink to fit when the grid is dense.

schema.label: Backdrop
schema.description: Wallpaper: the current wallpaper, blurred. Glass: frosted glass over the live desktop (needs the Hyprland blur rule from the README). Desktop: a tint over the live desktop. Solid: the theme background.

schema.label: Wallpaper blur
schema.description: 0 = sharp wallpaper, 1 = fully blurred. Wallpaper backdrop only.

schema.label: Dim
schema.description: Strength of the theme tint over the backdrop.

schema.label: Accent glow
schema.description: Soft accent-coloured glow above the search field.

schema.label: Animations
schema.description: Full: ripple entrance, zooms and springy hovers. Subtle: plain fades and slides. None: instant.
